Name: Prismatic Quality
Author: AvalonMFX
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/n9k82K7.png[/img]

[list]
[*]roughly 15% more valuable than Iridium in terms of Health, Energy and Money
[*]current multiplier 2.25 (will be changed to 2.5 soon but decrease the chance for acquiring prismatic quality)
[*]Chance for obtaining a prismatic quality item: [font=Courier New][b]chanceForIridiumQuality / 2[/b][/font]﻿
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/W1gSYfd.png[/img]

[list]
[*][color=#f1c232]The mod uses Harmony - This can cause mod-compatibility issues[/color]
[*][color=#6aa84f]Multiplayer compatible[/color]
[*][color=#6aa84f]Modded Items[/color]
[*][color=#f1c232]Compatible with with mods that modify the quality: [/color]There are some QoL mods that turn artisan goods into the quality of the ingredient. In theory it should work since Stardew handles the qualities and there is no much patching required. However, I didn't test it. Please let me know if you're facing any bugs.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/AHmm0Lp.png[/img]

[list]
[*]﻿[b]Prismatic for Botanist: [/b]Makes every item affected by this profession prismatic. Otherwise it will vary between iridium and prismatic
[/list]


[color=#6aa84f][size=5]Got any ideas or improvements to share?[/size]
[/color]
[color=#f4f4f4]Feel free to leave a comment or send me a message. I am always open for feedback :)
